notes: Dayton Street jogs at Whiteman: the west part (Linn to Whiteman, centre ~y2650) is about 300 px south of the east part (Whiteman to Central, centre ~y2350-2480); recorded as two T points on Whiteman, the southern one is really an L-corner where Whiteman ends. John Street also jogs at York: the north segment (Linnaeus to York, 20') is centred ~220 px east of the 50' south segment (York to Findlay); two T points on York. John/Linnaeus is effectively an L-corner (open brewery yard west of John is inside block 3, not a street). The alley south of York between Linn and John (x ~1000) is unlabelled on this sheet; recorded as Keywith Alley as the direct continuation. Charlotte Street does not reach Linn (starts at that alley) and is only ~18 ft wide east of John. Central Avenue: its east curb line is cut by the page edge south of about y5400, so the Charlotte/Central point is west curb + half width (less certain, maybe +-20 px); Central/Findlay lies off the page edge and is not recorded. Dayton, Linnaeus and York are T junctions at Central (sheet 218 shows the east side of Central closed at each); Charlotte crosses Central and continues east on sheet 218. Private Drive Way (brewery) and the curved stave-yard drive in block 6 are ignored.
